name: Fast Revision Purge
description: Ultra-fast dry-run planner and chunked purger for old node, paragraph, and Layout Builder revisions, with an admin UI and Drush commands.
project_description: Fast Revision Purge is an Administration-package tool that reclaims database space by deleting old node and paragraph revisions (and Layout Builder field-revision rows) in a two-step, dry-run-then-purge workflow. A Planner service (fast_revision_purge.planner) populates working tables (fastrev_node_keep/fastrev_node_delete, fastrev_par_in_use/fastrev_par_delete, and optional fastrev_lb_keep/fastrev_lb_delete) according to a retention policy: keep the latest N non-default node revisions (optionally per (nid, langcode)), keep revisions since a YYYY-MM-DD date, protect the latest published revision per node, and keep the last M paragraph revisions per paragraph entity. Paragraphs currently in use are found by walking entity_reference_revisions edges from kept node revisions with a bounded BFS (max 50 passes). A Purger service (fast_revision_purge.purger) then deletes staged revisions in configurable chunks (with optional inter-chunk sleep), removing field-revision rows before core revision rows and paragraphs before nodes. Table and column discovery is handled by RevisionTableMap using entity/field-storage definitions and information_schema, supporting both D10 and D11 Paragraphs schema variants; IndexManager can create helpful indexes; TableStats reports DB and top-table sizes; StatsStorage persists a singleton fastrev_stats row (cumulative deletions, estimated bytes freed, potential reclaimable space, and last dry-run/purge timestamps). The admin settings form at /admin/config/development/fast-revision-purge (permission 'administer site configuration') exposes the policy, execution tuning, a Danger-zone confirmation, optional dedicated Paragraph and Layout Builder truncators, a copy/paste sanity-query helper, and post-purge ANALYZE/OPTIMIZE SQL, running plan and purge through the Batch API. Drush commands fastrev:report, fastrev:purge, and fastrev:reindex (aliases fr:report, fr:purge, fr:reindex) drive the same flow from the CLI. Estimates are byte approximations from information_schema average row sizes; actual on-disk reclamation may require OPTIMIZE TABLE.
